hero.tagline: Everything Warframe in one place: wiki, event tracker, mod builder and interactive star chart. Live data, straight from the game.

about.title: About
about.text: Void Warframe is a fan-made companion site for Warframe. It brings together everything a player needs: a reference on frames, weapons and mods, real-time tracking of in-game events, a build planner, and an interactive Origin System map. Unofficial — not affiliated with Digital Extremes.
